description: Implementation of a service class for reading and fetching product-to-GL account mapping details for various financial products like loans, savings, and shares. Contains methods to retrieve account mappings based on accounting types, product IDs, and product types, including handling different accounting rules (cash-based, accrual, etc.) and mappings for payments, charges, classifications, and write-offs.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class to read and map product-to-GL account data for various product types and accounting rules.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches a map of account mapping details for a specified loan product based on the accounting type.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Fetches a map of account mapping details for savings product based on the accounting type.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves payment type to fund source mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves payment type to fund source mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Gets fee to income account mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Gets penalty to income account mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Gets fee to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Gets penalty to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchChargeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Retrieves charge-to-income account mappings for given product, product type, and penalty flag.

methods.name: fetchChargeOffReasonMappings
methods.description: Fetches charge-off reason mappings for a product.

methods.name: fetchWriteOffReasonMappings
methods.description: Fetches write-off reason mappings for a product.

methods.name: fetchClassificationMappings
methods.description: Retrieves classification-to-GL account mappings for a given product and classification parameter.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForShareProduct
methods.description: Fetches account mapping details for share products based on accounting rule type.

methods.name: setAccrualPeriodicSavingsProductToGLAccountMaps
methods.description: Helper method to set account mappings for accrual periodic savings products.

methods.name: setCashSavingsProductToGLAccountMaps
methods.description: Helper method to set account mappings for cash-based savings products.
